contexts.text: Their bodies and faces are made filthy.
These persuasions which are from the love of self, are most filthy; whereas persuasions from the love of the world are not so filthy.
From this good they are prone to filthy pleasures...
(In Heaven, such) feel the filthiness of their affections, thus infernal torment.
Will not (these truths) be made filthy...
The filthy things of infernal Spirits are blunted and made mild with the Angels.
Present beautiful things as filthy, and filthy ones as beautiful.
When the internal form is from the proprium, it is filthy.
That the filthy things of man are only hidden...
Bread cut into little cubes = filthy delights.
Sins are not remitted except from... an acknowledgement of filthiness... (Otherwise) he returns to his former filthiness.
They love only their filthy cupidities...
They are delighted with these foul and filthy things.
